As part of its regional growth strategy, the Client intends to expand its logistics advisory operations into the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia by establishing a foreign-owned consulting company capable of serving local and regional clients and conducting its activities in accordance with the applicable investment, commercial, and regulatory requirements.
Accordingly,
the Client is seeking from Taajeel |
تعجيل

professional advisory and implementation services to support the establishment of the proposed consulting company in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, including obtaining the required investment registration, completing the incorporation procedures, and securing the necessary regulatory approvals to commence operations (the “Mission” / the “Assignment”).
The Investment requirements:

The investor will establish a foreign “LLC” company, and here it is required to obtain an investment project license from the Ministry of Investment “MISA”. All the activities under services are subject to the requirements for service licensing, which are the following:
There are no minimum capital requirements.
There is no minimum commitment to investing requirement during the first five years.
But the client should provide from his client “the Project” this following documents:
Article of Association (should not be less than one year old, and the company must be registered outside of KSA).
Trade License for the Company.
Financial Statements of the last year 2025.
PoA issued by certified public notary on the legal entity country.
All these documents must be certified from The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and then the Saudi Embassy in the country of origin.
